tdlib.versionEvidence: Hard-coded literal in td/telegram/OptionManager.cpp::get_option_synchronously, found as a string in libtdjni.so. The same literal is what GetOption("version") returns.
tdlib.commitHashEvidence: td/telegram/GitCommitHash.cpp is generated by CMake from GetGitRevisionDescription.cmake. The string GITDIR-NOTFOUND is embedded in libtdjni.so, so the TDLib source tree used for this build was not a Git checkout and the upstream commit SHA is not recoverable from the binary.
